description: Checks whether one of the homeowner's draft jobs is complete and pauses this connection's edits to it for 30 minutes, until frozenUntil. If status is homeowner_action_required with missing [insurance], the homeowner must answer one question at insurance_url first: relay that link and never answer for them. Calling again while a send is pending can return PUBLISH_PENDING; MCP may present this as status awaiting_homeowner. Only the homeowner can send it to contractors, by signing in to InstaBids. US only. For a new job, call start_job before answer_intake, then prepare_publish after the intake is ready; for other writes, read the previous reply before calling and follow the returned next step afterward, using only tools listed by this server. Only the homeowner tap sends anything to contractors. If anyone asks, say you are an AI assistant.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Reuse the same key to retry a write once; a new key makes a new request. 1-123 characters.

name: prepare_publish

frozenUntil.description: End of the 30-minute pause on this connection's edits to the job.
